project_type: Vite 6 + React 18 + TypeScript PWA with Convex backend
build_system: Vite with tsc type-checking; Convex backend auto-generates types
test_framework: None yet - needs Vitest + React Testing Library + jsdom to be installed
build_command: npm run build (runs tsc && vite build)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compiles. 2. Run npx vitest run to verify all tests pass.
snapshot_or_generated_files: convex/_generated/ directory is auto-generated by npx convex dev - do not manually edit. No snapshot tests.
setup_instructions: npm install to install deps. No npx convex dev needed since _generated files already exist.
environment_constraints: Full internet access available. No Docker daemon needed. Convex backend cannot be run locally (cloud service) so backend tests must mock Convex internals.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns.
key_patterns: Icons use IconLibrary.tsx wrapper around lucide-react. Components use shadcn/ui (Radix + tailwind). Hooks in src/hooks/. Convex actions/mutations/queries in convex/. Path alias @/ -> src/. OneSignal initialized via react-onesignal package. Module-level flag prevents re-init.
directory_structure: src/components/ - React components including UI (shadcn). src/hooks/ - custom hooks. src/lib/ - utilities (convexClient, queryClient, utils, FilterContext). src/utils/ - utility functions. convex/ - Convex backend (schema, mutations, actions, queries). convex/sync/ - data sync actions.
